title: Uruguayan Sirloin Steak Grill
description: A hearty Uruguayan dish featuring a katsuramuki-cut sirloin steak, seasoned with Uruguayan spices, and seared to perfection in a kadhai. This recipe is perfect for a solo dinner.

ingredients.name: Uruguayan chimichurri mix
ingredients.notes: available at most Latin American grocery stores

instructions: Heat the kadhai over medium-high heat for 5 minutes.
Add the olive oil to the kadhai and brush it evenly to prevent sticking.
Season the sirloin steak with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and red pepper flakes.
Sear the sirloin steak in the kadhai for 3-4 minutes per side, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
Transfer the sirloin steak to a plate and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Stir the Uruguayan chimichurri mix into the remaining juices in the kadhai.
Serve the sirloin steak with the chimichurri sauce spooned over the top and garnished with chopped parsley.
